summary: Iteration 4 backend testing (GLOBAL-readiness). Wrote /app/backend/tests/test_global_v1.py with 25 tests spanning: regression (admin login, feras-askar English base, admin cards, QR/poster PNG, multi-tenant zero-cards), /api/markets shape, regional pricing for US/AE/GB, plan-set stability across markets, register-with-region (AE/ar/AED and US defaults), localized public profile (?lang=ar, unsupported lang fallback, no-lang base), AI multilingual follow-up (ar with rtl:true, es, en, all returning provider='template' with review-only note), Super Admin global config (GET /api/admin/markets, 403 for non-admin, PUT plan pricing round-trip with restore to 3900/29900, PUT market field with restore), and international contact + languages/i18n round-trip via admin card create+update+delete. All 25 new tests pass. Re-ran prior 62 tests (test_commercial_v1.py + test_new_features.py + backend_test.py) — 62/62 also pass. Total 87/87 backend tests passing. Restored /api/admin/plans/pro/pricing/AE to {month:3900, year:29900} and market AE 'name' to 'United Arab Emirates' after mutation tests. No changes made to production code — testing-only.

minor.issue: When lang is present but not in card.languages, response returns _activeLang=default (en) but SILENTLY drops the client's requested lang code; consider echoing back requested_lang for observability. Behavior itself is correct per spec (fallback to English).
Draft is always deterministic template — EMERGENT_LLM_KEY is configured but not wired to an LLM. Not a bug per code comment ('future LLM wiring'), but marketing 'AI' is currently canned text.

critical_code_review_comments: platform_v1.default_region hard-codes locale as '<lang>-<country>' (e.g. 'ar-AE'). For AE the DEFAULT_MARKETS entry uses default_language='en' so a user registering with country='AE' and language='ar' still gets locale 'ar-AE' (because register() overrides default_language=lang before deriving locale... actually locale is set from DEFAULT_MARKETS then not recomputed after language override). Locale of returned user came out as expected in tests ('AE' present) but confirm downstream date/number formatting picks the user's language, not the market default.
/api/pricing falls back to DEFAULT_MARKETS[0] (US) for unknown market codes silently — consider 400 for unknown market to prevent hidden currency mismatches in checkout.
PUT /api/admin/plans/{plan_id}/pricing/{market} uses upsert=True on the plan and accepts arbitrary month/year (no non-negative int validation, no currency-consistency check with market).
PUT /api/admin/markets/{code} accepts arbitrary body dict and merges via $set — a malicious/erroneous payload could overwrite 'currency' or 'active' without validation. Add a Pydantic model.

_apply_lang mutates the card dict in place and also relies on card.get('languages')[0] as default. Empty languages list would 500; defensive fallback already prevents that but consider guarding an empty list explicitly.
_draft_followup uses non-LLM deterministic templates despite EMERGENT_LLM_KEY being set — either wire the LLM or update the /api/config marketing claim.

RegisterIn.country_code has no length/enum validation; passing e.g. 'ZZ' silently resolves to US defaults. Consider validating against SUPPORTED market codes or explicitly returning fallback info in response.
